purpose: Initialized user Iterator rewinds after literal native send selected old Generator; rewind rebinds target/clears Iterator CV, current copies Token before key overwrites its property. Iterator DATA retires before old-target body; copied Token then retires before selected Generator finally and caller result.

<?php
class Token116A {
    function __destruct() { global $weakTarget, $weakIterator, $weakToken; echo 'TOKEN|', $weakTarget->get() instanceof Generator, '|', $weakIterator->get() === null, '|', $weakToken->get() === $this, '|'; }
}
class Input116A implements Iterator {
    public $value;
    private $done = false;
    function __construct($value) { $this->value = $value; }
    function rewind(): void { global $target, $replacement, $iterator, $weakTarget, $weakIterator, $weakToken; echo 'REWIND|'; $target = $replacement; $iterator = null; echo 'HELD|', $weakTarget->get() instanceof Generator, '|', $weakIterator->get() === $this, '|', $weakToken->get() === $this->value, '|'; }
    function valid(): bool { echo 'VALID|'; return !$this->done; }
    function current(): mixed { echo 'CURRENT|'; return $this->value; }
    function key(): mixed { echo 'KEY|'; $this->value = 17; return 0; }
    function next(): void { echo 'NEXT|'; $this->done = true; }
    function __destruct() { global $weakTarget, $weakToken; echo 'ITER|', $weakTarget->get() instanceof Generator, '|', $weakToken->get() instanceof Token116A, '|'; }
}
function target116A($name) {
    try { echo 'INIT|', $name, '|'; $received = yield 'head'; global $weakToken; echo 'GOT|', $received === $weakToken->get(), '|'; unset($received); yield 'tail'; }
    finally { global $weakTarget; echo 'FIN|', $name, '|', $weakTarget->get() instanceof Generator, '|'; }
}
$target = target116A('old'); $replacement = target116A('new'); $weakTarget = WeakReference::create($target);
$token = new Token116A; $weakToken = WeakReference::create($token); $iterator = new Input116A($token); $weakIterator = WeakReference::create($iterator); $token = null;
echo 'CALL|'; $result = $target->send(...$iterator);
echo 'RETURN|', $result === 'tail', '|', $target === $replacement, '|', $weakTarget->get() === null, '|', $weakIterator->get() === null, '|', $weakToken->get() === null, '|DONE|';

purpose: One Iterator CV pack preserves named value, duplicate/order pre-API errors without initialization, and excess/empty count errors with actual Generator frame/argv; later named scalar send recovers the same fresh target.

<?php
class Input116M implements Iterator {
    private $keys; private $values; private $limit; private $position = 0;
    function __construct($keys, $values, $limit) { $this->keys = $keys; $this->values = $values; $this->limit = $limit; }
    function rewind(): void { $this->position = 0; }
    function valid(): bool { return $this->position < $this->limit; }
    function current(): mixed { return $this->values[$this->position]; }
    function key(): mixed { return $this->keys[$this->position]; }
    function next(): void { $this->position++; }
}
function flow116M() { global $initialized; $initialized++; echo 'INIT|'; $received = yield 'head'; echo 'GOT|', $received, '|'; yield 'tail'; }
$initialized = 0; $target = flow116M();
$duplicate = new Input116M(['value', 'value'], [11, 22], 2);
try { $target->send(...$duplicate); }
catch (Error $e) { echo 'DUP|', $e->getMessage() === 'Named parameter $value overwrites previous argument', '|', $e->getTrace() === [], '|', $initialized === 0, '|'; }
$order = new Input116M(['value', 0], [11, 22], 2);
try { $target->send(...$order); }
catch (Error $e) { echo 'ORDER|', $e->getMessage() === 'Cannot use positional argument after named argument during unpacking', '|', $e->getTrace() === [], '|', $initialized === 0, '|'; }
$count = new Input116M([0, 1], [11, 22], 2);
try { $target->send(...$count); }
catch (ArgumentCountError $e) { $trace = $e->getTrace(); echo 'COUNT|', $e->getMessage() === 'Generator::send() expects exactly 1 argument, 2 given', '|', $trace[0]['class'] === 'Generator', '|', $trace[0]['function'] === 'send', '|', $trace[0]['args'] === [11, 22], '|', !isset($trace[1]), '|', $initialized === 0, '|'; }
$empty = new Input116M([], [], 0);
try { $target->send(...$empty); }
catch (ArgumentCountError $e) { $trace = $e->getTrace(); echo 'EMPTY|', $e->getMessage() === 'Generator::send() expects exactly 1 argument, 0 given', '|', $trace[0]['class'] === 'Generator', '|', $trace[0]['args'] === [], '|', !isset($trace[1]), '|', $initialized === 0, '|'; }
$named = new Input116M(['value'], [41], 1);
echo 'VALID|', $target->send(...$named), '|', $initialized === 1, '|DONE|';

purpose: Ordinary positional counterpart of the receiver-pin repair. Sole receiver survives argv destructor and reentrant next cache release; saved owning return stays live, unused return drops before receiver, used return escapes or outlives receiver on supplied Stop. Cleanup traces are caller-only.

<?php
class Stop116D extends Exception {}
class Return116D {
    function __construct() { global $weakReturn; $weakReturn = WeakReference::create($this); }
    function __destruct() { global $weakTarget, $weakArgument; echo 'RET|', $weakTarget->get() === null, '|', $weakArgument->get() === null, '|'; }
}
class Argument116D {
    function __construct() { global $weakArgument; $weakArgument = WeakReference::create($this); }
    function __destruct() {
        global $weakTarget, $weakReturn, $throws, $stop;
        echo 'ARG|', $weakTarget->get() instanceof Generator, '|', $weakReturn->get() instanceof Return116D, '|';
        $probe = new Exception('probe'); $trace = $probe->getTrace();
        echo 'TRACE|', $trace[0]['function'] === '__destruct', '|', $trace[1]['function'] === 'run116D', '|', !isset($trace[2]), '|'; unset($trace, $probe);
        $weakTarget->get()->next();
        echo 'KEPT|', $weakReturn->get() instanceof Return116D, '|';
        if ($throws) { throw $stop; }
    }
}
function flow116D() { try { $received = yield 'head'; global $weakArgument; echo 'GOT|', $received === $weakArgument->get(), '|'; unset($received); yield new Return116D; } finally { global $weakTarget; echo 'FIN|', $weakTarget->get() instanceof Generator, '|'; } }
function argument116D() { global $target, $weakTarget; $target = null; echo 'HELD|', $weakTarget->get() instanceof Generator, '|'; return new Argument116D; }
function run116D($used, $throwing) {
    global $target, $weakTarget, $weakArgument, $weakReturn, $throws, $stop;
    $throws = $throwing; $target = flow116D(); $weakTarget = WeakReference::create($target);
    echo $used ? 'USED|' : 'UNUSED|', $throwing ? 'THROW|' : 'NORMAL|';
    try {
        if ($used) { $result = $target->send(argument116D()); echo 'HELD-RETURN|', $result instanceof Return116D, '|', $weakTarget->get() === null, '|'; unset($result); }
        else { $target->send(argument116D()); }
        echo 'RETURN|', $weakTarget->get() === null, '|', $weakArgument->get() === null, '|', $weakReturn->get() === null, '|';
    } catch (Stop116D $caught) { echo 'CATCH|', $caught === $stop, '|', $caught->getPrevious() === null, '|', $caught->getTrace() === [], '|', $weakTarget->get() === null, '|', $weakArgument->get() === null, '|', $weakReturn->get() === null, '|'; }
}
$stop = new Stop116D('given'); run116D(false, false); run116D(true, false); run116D(false, true); run116D(true, true); echo 'DONE|';
